messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Patients on Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly lost an average of 20.9% or 48.6 lb of their body weight after 72 weeks.
This data comes from the Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622).
Placebo patients lost an average of 3.1% or 7.2 lb.
Study 1 was a 72-week trial.
The trial compared Zepbound weight loss with placebo.
The trial included adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition.
The trial excluded patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight
Zepbound 5 mg | 15.0% | 34.0 lb | 226.9 lb
Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb
Zepbound 15 mg | 20.9% | 48.6 lb | 232.8 lb
Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triplet: ["Placebo", "has weight loss result", "3.1% or 7.2 lb"]

The relation 'has weight loss result' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or group resulted in the specified average weight loss.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has eradication rate': The subject therapy achieves the specified rate of eradication of the target condition.
B. 'per 1,000 patients treated': The subject difference or outcome is measured or expressed in terms of the number of patients per 1,000 treated, as specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effect in': The subject drug has a specific effect or behavior in the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
D. 'has usual adult dose': The subject condition or regimen has a standard dose for adults specified by the object entity.
E. 'has participant': The study or trial specified by the subject entity includes the group or treatment specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
